title: Cambridge City Council votes to temporarily restore controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Cambridge City Council voted 6-3 to temporarily restore ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology in areas where it was previously used.
The decision follows a fatal shooting on July 4, spurring debate over ShotSpotter's effectiveness and public safety in Cambridge.
A resident assembly will review the system and make recommendations within 90 days while the technology remains active.

title: 4 takeaways from Craig Breslow’s Red Sox trade-deadline press conference
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquire Adley Rutschman, trading catcher Carlos Narvaez and prospects Anthony Eyanson, Kyson Witherspoon, and Enddy Azocar to the Orioles.
Marcelo Mayer traded to the Giants in exchange for lefty reliever Erik Miller, following concerns about Mayer's durability and performance.
Franklin Arias, a promising 20-year-old shortstop, may fill Boston's future franchise shortstop role amid recent roster changes.

title: ‘Playbook of destruction’: Markey, Moulton meet for combative second debate ahead of Sept. primary
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton held a heated debate on August 3 ahead of the September primary.
The debate focused on age, military spending, and both candidates claiming the progressive label.
Markey denied any ties to Jeffrey Epstein, while Moulton defended investments tied to his wife's income.

title: 4 unproven Patriots players who are standing out at training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon, a third-round pick, is emerging as a solid target for Patriots' quarterbacks during training camp.
Undrafted free agent Tanner Arkin is proving to be a strong blocker and contributor in the team's run game.
Rookie Karon Prunty and undrafted linebacker Khalil Jacobs are making themselves contenders for valuable spots on the roster.

title: After jokes on GBH, state senator says agritourism like corn mazes are serious business
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Massachusetts Senator Jo Comerford emphasizes agritourism's importance amid financial struggles for farmers, proposing a $5 million investment.
Hosts Jim Braude and Margery Eagan jesting about corn mazes prompted Comerford's response highlighting the seriousness of farming challenges.
Comerford's agritourism amendment passed, part of a broader 'fun agenda' seeking to enhance cultural and promotional activities.

title: Red Sox trade Marcelo Mayer to Giants for reliever Erik Miller
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox traded shortstop Marcelo Mayer to Giants for left-handed reliever Erik Miller and minor league outfielder Carlos Gutierrez.
Mayer, once a top prospect, played 114 games for Boston with a .223 batting average, hindered by injuries.
Erik Miller posted a 2.76 ERA in 38 appearances for the Giants, adding depth to Boston's bullpen.

title: Patriots sign former Giants defensive tackle Casey Rogers
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: The Patriots have signed Casey Rogers, a 27-year-old defensive tackle, formerly with the Giants' and Bills' practice squads.
Rogers played 10 games for the DC Defenders in the United Football League, recording 21 tackles and 1.5 sacks.
Rogers joins an already strong Patriots' defensive line, practicing in Foxborough and wearing jersey number 96.

title: 5 things to know about new Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Boston Red Sox acquired catcher Adley Rutschman from the Baltimore Orioles before Monday's MLB trade deadline.
Trade included Red Sox sending Carlos Narvaez and three prospects to Orioles for Rutschman and Jake Rogers.
Rutschman is a three-time All-Star with strong defensive skills but has faced recent injury setbacks.

title: 5 takeaways from Day 8 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Receiver A.J. Brown continued his performance despite dislocating his thumb during Patriots training camp practice.
Efton Chism had a notable day, catching several touchdowns during the scrimmages at Patriots training camp.
Undrafted cornerback Channing Canada made a strong impression with several pass breakups during the practice session.

title: Ballot Brief: Your guide to the 2026 midterms
author: Zipporah Osei
bullets: Ballot Brief is Boston.com's free newsletter for the 2026 Massachusetts midterms election coverage.
The newsletter covers races including governor, U.S. Senate, congressional, district attorney, and nine ballot questions.
Early voting starts August 22; primaries are scheduled for September 1, 2026, in Massachusetts.
